# pnpm skill smoke check

This is an inert, repository-local delivery fixture, not a development workflow.
When explicitly invoked, read [reference.md](reference.md) beside this file and
report its marker verbatim. Do not run commands, access the network, modify files,
or change agent settings. Report the path from which this skill was loaded.
